headline: Iranian oil supplies to Asia dry up ahead of new US sanctions
summary: Iranian oil supplies to Asia have practically stopped, and freight rates reached multi-year highs before Washington announced new measures. The reports cite the impending US sanctions.
why: Iran is an OPEC producer whose crude flows to Asian buyers influence global oil supply, while tanker freight rates reflect shipping demand and vessel availability.
why_moved: Iranian supplies to Asia have practically stopped and freight rates hit multi-year highs before new US measures were announced.
